Description:
[center][quote]

[center]A mysterious, but fiery figure shows up in the Cindersap Forest, claiming she's lost her hat.
Her name is Drachma and she'll be staying here for a while. She appears to be mainly strolling around and sleeping (and accepting common folks' offering of course), but once in a while you can notice the suspicious attempts at harnessing the Valley's magical forces. Soon, as she says, you'll be able to experience the greatest adventure of your life - she's, of course, planning to take you on the hat hunt with her. [/center]


[size=3]
The mod adds a custom, non-romanceable NPC Drachma. She has set dialogue for every day of the week per season, special gift dialogues and pretty sprites and portraits made from scratch by me :3
No events yet! They're still in development >.<, but let's just say that Drachma's taking a bit longer with her preparation to make the hunt more memorable and explosive!


I haven't tested the mod's compatibility with SVE.

Gift preferences:
Drachma likes all metal goods[/size]




*Veeery early version - this was a rushed entry for the Modfest, but the project is very much real, in development and hopefully soon released ^^
Thank you to everyone who tried it out, shared their opinions and suggestions and gave me the motivation to continue working on this mod :)
Thank you Eli0630 for the Spanish translation!!
